steps.title: Initialize Web Project Structure
steps.description: Set up the basic file structure for a new web application, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files.

steps.title: Define Application Metadata
steps.description: Create the app-meta.json file to specify the application's name and type.

steps.title: Configure Backend Schema
steps.description: Generate the api_schema.json file, disabling backend functionality as this landing page is frontend-only.

steps.title: Create Basic HTML Structure
steps.description: Develop the foundational HTML document with a head, body, and essential meta tags.

steps.title: Implement Tailwind CSS Integration
steps.description: Add the Tailwind CSS CDN to index.html for rapid styling and responsive design.

steps.title: Design Navigation Bar
steps.description: Create a responsive navigation bar with a logo and menu links, including a mobile toggle.

steps.title: Develop Hero Section
steps.description: Build the main hero section with a compelling title, description, and call-to-action button.

steps.title: Add Features Section
steps.description: Implement a section to showcase key features of the service or product using cards.

steps.title: Create About Section
steps.description: Design an 'About Us' section to provide more details about the project or company.

steps.title: Implement Contact Section
steps.description: Add a contact section with placeholder information or a simple contact form layout.

steps.title: Develop Footer Section
steps.description: Construct a footer with copyright information and navigation links.

steps.title: Add Responsive Design Considerations
steps.description: Ensure the layout is responsive across various screen sizes using Tailwind CSS utility classes.

steps.title: Implement Mobile Navigation Toggle
steps.description: Write JavaScript to handle the opening and closing of the mobile navigation menu.

steps.title: Building landingpage
steps.description: The landingpage web application is now fully defined and ready for deployment.
